Scoped deliberately: the Data_Layer only ever touches its own single table
and its four GSIs, and the voice layer only invokes the Nova Sonic model.

ResourceComment: Both real Nova Sonic ids. Note the v2 model is 'amazon.nova-2-sonic-v1:0',
NOT 'amazon.nova-sonic-v2:0' — the latter does not exist, and granting it
instead of the real v2 id fails the voice path with AccessDeniedException.
These must match strands NOVA_SONIC_V1_MODEL_ID / NOVA_SONIC_V2_MODEL_ID.

SidComment: Two prefixes, both in CLINIC_RECORDINGS_BUCKET / CLINIC_DOCUMENTS_BUCKET.
call-recordings/ is call audio, written only when CLINIC_RECORDINGS_BUCKET
is set. clinic-documents/ holds the clinic briefing the agent reads at the
start of every session — without GetObject on it the call still connects
but the agent answers with no knowledge of the clinic.
Deliberately grants no s3:DeleteObject: audio is expired by a bucket
lifecycle rule, not by the application.
Only needed when recordings use SSE-KMS (CLINIC_RECORDINGS_SSE=aws:kms).
